prompt: In my Godot 4 project I pasted a Godot 3 player script. It extends KinematicBody, calls `velocity = move_and_slide(velocity, Vector3.UP)` and waits with `yield(get_tree().create_timer(0.5), "timeout")`. The editor reports parse errors. Explain the cause and the fix in prose, naming the exact Godot 4 classes and APIs.

replaces yield with await

uses the built-in velocity property
